text.zh: 他在萨里郡一所私立寄宿学校读书。
text.en: He attends a private boarding school in Surrey.

text.zh: 七岁时他的志向是当传教士。
text.en: At seven his ambition is to become a missionary.

text.zh: 他不和父母同住；父亲是驻南罗得西亚的军人，远在六千英里外。
text.en: He does not live with his parents; his father, a soldier in Southern Rhodesia, is 6,000 miles away.

text.zh: 他住在萨里郡的私立寄宿学校，不与父母同住。
text.en: He lives at his private boarding school in Surrey rather than with his parents.

text.zh: 他就读于伦敦圣保罗公学，11 岁起在那里寄宿。
text.en: He is at St Paul's School in London, which he joined as a boarder at 11.

text.zh: 他不再想当传教士，说自己没法跟人谈论这些。
text.en: He no longer wants to be a missionary, saying he could not talk about it to people.

text.zh: 他与继父相处融洽，偶尔见到从罗得西亚回来的父亲。
text.en: He gets on well with his stepfather and sees his father, who comes over from Rhodesia, occasionally.

text.zh: 他寄宿在伦敦的圣保罗公学。
text.en: He boards at St Paul's School in London.

text.zh: 他 11 岁转入伦敦圣保罗公学寄宿，14 岁时去了罗得西亚（今津巴布韦）。
text.en: He moved to St Paul's School in London as a boarder at 11, and at 14 went out to Rhodesia (now Zimbabwe).

text.zh: 他说自己对信仰有兴趣，但宁愿把它留给自己。
text.en: He says he is interested in faith himself but would rather keep it private.

text.zh: 他在牛津大学大学学院读数学，正值最后一年。
text.en: He is in his final year reading mathematics at University College, Oxford.

text.zh: 他想找绘制地图的工作，但觉得这次大概错过了机会。
text.en: He would like a job making maps, but thinks he has probably missed the chance this time.

text.zh: 他没有女朋友；母亲离婚后，他与继父和一位半血亲姐妹相处融洽。
text.en: He has no girlfriend; since his mother's divorce he has got on well with his stepfather and half-sister.

text.zh: 上大学前九个月的空档里，他在一所残障儿童学校教书，还在班伯里污水处理厂干过。
text.en: In a nine-month gap before university he taught at a school for handicapped children and worked at Banbury sewage works.

text.zh: 他说影响自己最深的，是不想辜负为供他上学而辛苦工作的母亲。
text.en: He says his strongest influence is not wanting to let down his mother, who worked hard to get him through school.

text.zh: 他读过预备学校、名牌公学和牛津大学，在牛津读数学。
text.en: He went to a prep school, a major public school and Oxford, where he read maths.

text.zh: 在伦敦金融城工作三年后，他在伦敦东区 Tony 的母校教数学。
text.en: After three years working in the City, he teaches maths at Tony's old school in London's East End.

text.zh: 他说非常希望拥有自己的家庭，觉得这是自己应当满足的需要。
text.en: He says he would very much like a family of his own, a need he feels he ought to fulfil.

text.zh: 他住在伦敦东区的一套市政公寓里，步行即可到学校。
text.en: He lives in a council flat in London's East End, within walking distance of his school.

text.zh: 他离开金融城的保险公司，毫无经验地转行教书，五周内就站上讲台。
text.en: He left an insurance company in the City to go into teaching with no experience, and was in a classroom within five weeks.

text.zh: 他并不失望：教书工作很难，而取得的成绩令他满足。
text.en: He feels no disappointment: his teaching job is difficult, and he finds its successes satisfying.

text.zh: 他拥有牛津大学的数学学位。
text.en: He holds a mathematics degree from Oxford.

text.zh: 他是伦敦的教师，在孟加拉国锡尔赫特待一学期，教数学和英语并协助设计课程。
text.en: A London teacher, he is spending a term in Sylhet, Bangladesh, teaching maths and English and helping design courses.

text.zh: 他还没有结婚，说大概是没遇到合适的人。
text.en: He has not married, saying he supposes he has not met the right person.

text.zh: 这一学期他住在孟加拉国锡尔赫特市中心的简陋住处。
text.en: For the term he lives in primitive lodgings in the middle of Sylhet, Bangladesh.

text.zh: 他的父亲从津巴布韦退休回英国后，约三年前去世，享年 72 岁。
text.en: His father, who had retired to England from Zimbabwe, died about three years earlier, aged 72.

text.zh: 他说自己把握住了机会，找到了让他有成就感的工作。
text.en: He says he has made the most of his opportunity by finding work he finds rewarding.

text.zh: 他拥有牛津大学的数学学位。
text.en: He holds a mathematics degree from Oxford.

text.zh: 他在伦敦东区一所天主教女校任数学系主任，已在那里工作约五年。
text.en: He heads the maths department at a Roman Catholic girls' school in London's East End, where he has been about five years.

text.zh: 去年夏天他与同校教师 Penny 结婚；两人说也许会要孩子。
text.en: He married Penny, a teacher at his school, the previous summer; they say they may have children.

text.zh: 他住在伦敦；Neil 从设得兰搬到伦敦后，在他家借住了约两个月。
text.en: He lives in London; Neil lodged with him for about two months after moving there from Shetland.

text.zh: 他去年夏天与 Penny 结婚，Neil 在婚礼上担任朗读。
text.en: He married Penny the previous summer, and Neil gave a reading at the wedding.

text.zh: 他形容自己正处于知足的中年状态，庆幸找到了 Penny。
text.en: He describes himself as contentedly middle-aged and feels lucky to have found Penny.

text.zh: 他拥有牛津大学的数学学位。
text.en: He holds a mathematics degree from Oxford.

text.zh: 他在圣奥尔本斯学校教数学，那是一所大型男子私校，预科阶段招收女生。
text.en: He teaches maths at St Albans, a large boys' independent school with girls in the sixth form.

text.zh: 他和 Penny 育有两个年幼的儿子 Henry 和 George。
text.en: He and Penny have two young sons, Henry and George.

text.zh: 五年前，全家从伦敦东区搬到他的新学校——赫特福德郡圣奥尔本斯学校附近。
text.en: Five years earlier the family moved from the East End to be near his new school, St Albans School in Hertfordshire.

text.zh: 他被市内学校的教学消磨殆尽，转到圣奥尔本斯学校；他和 Penny 生了两个儿子。
text.en: Worn down by inner-city teaching, he moved to St Albans School; he and Penny had two sons.

text.zh: 他意外地发现自己知足、还算幸福，但觉得梦想已让位于日常家庭生活。
text.en: He is surprised to find himself contented and reasonably happy, though he feels dreams give way to everyday family life.

text.zh: 他拥有牛津大学的数学学位。
text.en: He holds a mathematics degree from Oxford.

text.zh: 他仍在圣奥尔本斯学校教数学，说自己乐于只做一名普通数学老师。
text.en: He still teaches maths at St Albans School and says he is happy just being an ordinary maths teacher.

text.zh: 他和 Penny 有两个儿子 Henry 和 George，都在 Penny 任教的贵格会学校上学。
text.en: He and Penny have two sons, Henry and George, who attend the local Quaker school where Penny teaches.

text.zh: 他把与父亲的隔阂归因于分离和距离，两人之间有许多需要弥补。
text.en: He puts the gap with his father down to separation and distance, leaving a lot of ground to make up.

text.zh: 他拥有牛津大学的数学学位。
text.en: He holds a mathematics degree from Oxford.

text.zh: 他的工作生涯大体结束，只在 Penny 的学校兼一点课，并任贵格会司库。
text.en: Most of his working life is over; he teaches a little at Penny's school and is treasurer for the Quakers.

text.zh: 他与任预科部主任的 Penny 结婚；两个儿子分别 19 岁和 17 岁。
text.en: He is married to Penny, a head of sixth form; their two sons are 19 and 17.

text.zh: 回首往事，他觉得有很多美好：幸福的婚姻、两个出色的儿子和一份事业。
text.en: Looking back, he sees much to be fond of: a happy marriage, two fine sons and a body of work.

text.zh: 他拥有牛津大学的数学学位。
text.en: He holds a mathematics degree from Oxford.

text.zh: 他已完全退休，不再教书。
text.en: He has retired completely from teaching.

text.zh: 他现已完全退休，在当地皇家救生艇协会（RNLI）做志愿者，每周三晚参加训练。
text.en: He has now retired completely, and volunteers with the local RNLI lifeboat branch, training on Wednesday evenings.
Fully retired after a long career as a maths teacher, he starts each day walking the dogs on the beach, sings in a choir and volunteers with the RNLI lifeboat service.
text.zh: 他在长期担任数学教师后已完全退休，每天以在海滩遛狗开始，参加合唱团，并在皇家救生艇协会（RNLI）做志愿者。
